name: hmi_create_navigation_button
description: Create a new HMI button with an explicit Tapped action that navigates to an existing screen. Existing item names are never overwritten.

target_name.description: Exact HMI software name from hmi_list_targets.

item_name.description: New button item name; collisions fail without replacement.

text.description: Plain-text button caption. Plain Unicode text (ä, ö, å, °); the server wraps and escapes it as HTML, so do not use HTML entities.

destination_screen.description: Exact unique destination screen name in the selected HMI software.

back_color.description: Optional color: #RRGGBB, #AARRGGBB, or white, gray, grey, red, green, blue, transparent.

fore_color.description: Optional color: #RRGGBB, #AARRGGBB, or white, gray, grey, red, green, blue, transparent.
